'''Rystáll Sant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] half [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] and half [[Human/Legends|Human]] dancer who worked for the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]. She was a [[near-Human]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]], born to a [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] father and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] mother.

==Biography==
Rystáll never knew her biological father. Her mother, [[Cyl Sant]], abandoned her as a baby after they moved from [[New Bornalex/Legends|New Bornalex]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There she was adopted by an [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] couple who worked as musicians. Rystáll became a dancer in their performances.<ref name="I67" />

In her younger days, Rystáll was a patron of the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> seen wearing only the finest [[Body glove/Legends|attire]], including a cape gifted to her by a passing admirer named [[Syrh Rhoams/Legends|Syrh Rhoams]].<ref name="SWCE" /> Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rystáll and her adoptive parents were enslaved by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] who had apparently become infatuated with the young dancer, though since he later put up the Sant family for a wager in a heated [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game, he seemed to care little for his slaves. Fortunately for Rystáll and her parents, a young [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] won them, and as Lando despised slavery, he set the trio free.<ref name="SWCE" /> The Ortolans then contacted their friend [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]], who agreed to hire Rystáll as a dancer and backup singer for his band.

[[File:SantAndFett-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|250px|Sant in approached by Boba Fett]]
Rystáll performed in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] attempt to rescue his friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Rystáll's graceful form and beautiful, exotic features, accentuated by her luxurious szona body glove, attracted the attention of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who engaged in conversation with the dancer prior to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] arrival at the palace.

Rystáll, along with [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]] (who had danced with her at Jabba's Palace), later joined a band known as [[The Palpatones]]. Although Greeata served as lead singer, as part of the band, Rystáll still gained fame for her musical ability. Her tenure with The Palpatones eventually brought her to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where she met fellow [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Shug Ninx]]. While on Nar Shaddaa, Rystáll discovered that her father was among the last of the Theelin species. She then left The Palpatones in order to locate information on who her father was.

==Behind the scenes==
Rystáll was first seen in the extended musical number in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], where she was played by dancer [[Mercedes Ngoh]].
